# PrivateDAO machine discovery

The human-facing PrivateDAO site publishes product and trust information.
For machine-native service discovery, use the isolated AWS Agent Exchange:

https://agents.privatedao.org/.well-known/agent-card.json
https://agents.privatedao.org/openapi.json
https://agents.privatedao.org/mcp
https://agents.privatedao.org/llms.txt
